fact.body: Peer stories only. Links not media. This is a conversation room, not a dating app, not therapy, and not medical advice. Gift talk is consumer-protection honesty — free boards on the rail (USAGov Scams, FTC Consumer Advice), not an affiliate mall. Sample posts are dress rehearsal, not live volume. Preview / noindex. No GTM. Welcomes iced. No cold invites from this page.

description: Peer relationship stories — wins, fights, dates, gifts. Warm table talk, not a dating funnel. Not therapy. Preview.
exploreExplainer: boyfriendchat is a table for high-intensity relationship stories — dating-app energy without the funnel. You bring a win, a fight, a date that flopped, a gift that landed. Peers talk. Nobody here is your therapist, your matchmaker, or your checkout cart.
trustBlurb: What boyfriendchat will not do: dating-funnel cosplay, therapy claims, NSFW dump, predatory DMs, or fake gift rankings. Peer stories. Gift talk is consumer-protection honesty, not an affiliate mall. Preview on purpose. No GTM. Welcomes iced until kill-switch.
